Coram : AR. LAKSHMANAN*, ALTAMAS KABIR
Constitution of India-Article 136-Appointment of a General category candidate on temporary basis to a Reserved post due to non-availability C of required candidate every year for five successive academic years-Writ Petition by appointee to de-reserve the post and regularise her services as per basis of false misrepresentation by University-Review petition by appointee was also dismissed on misrepresentation-Correctness of-Held, on facts on record, University made false misrepresentation before High Court-Hence directions D given to regularise the services of the appointee. Appellant
Decision Date : 13-02-2007 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 744/2007 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
